services.name: Tank trouble visit
services.story: A tank trouble visit: the $85 trip and check is promised; the fix is priced at the tank; the saved card is charged at DONE.

services.name: Tank move and setup
services.story: A 90-gallon reef tank moved and set up, quoted at $1,200 from photos: $600 now, $600 on the bill when it's set up.

services.name: Reef tank care visit
services.story: An office lobby tank on the office's account: each visit goes on one bill a month.

services_shape: visits to homes and offices to care for aquariums (a water change, glass and decor cleaning, filter care, a water test, a livestock check), one time or on a repeat plan; trouble visits priced at the visit; tank moves and new setups quoted from photos first; at the shop: water tests and fish holding
questions_before_times: at the shop or at your place
one visit or a repeat plan
for trouble: what's wrong (cloudy water, a leak, equipment stopped, fish dying)
safety_stop: water leaking near outlets, a power strip or cords
a shock from the tank water or equipment
sparks, smoke or a burning smell from a heater, light or pump
the glass cracked or the tank burst and water spreading
a sting from a lionfish or another venomous animal
coral toxin in the eyes or mouth, or trouble breathing after handling coral rock
license: None for aquarium care in most places: a business registration, the business's own word. Where the state's rules require a pet or animal dealer license to sell live fish, corals or other animals, the business says it holds one (a generic switch) before livestock is sold at a visit.
